//: Who may run what, when SIA's coding agent works in this repository.
//docs: sia permissions — the effective policy. sia permissions check '<cmd>' — why.
//mode: auto = only dangerous things ask | ask = only allowlisted things run | full = no gate

permissions.//: Rules are literal, never patterns: Bash(.*) means a program named `.*`.
permissions.//allow: Bash(awk:*) — awk with any arguments. Bash(pwd) — exactly pwd.
permissions.//ask: Stop and ask, even in auto mode.
permissions.//deny: Refuse outright. Checked first, so a deny always wins.
permissions.//deny2: A deny with no / in it matches that filename anywhere, and also
permissions.//deny3: covers `cat .env` — best effort against argv, not a sandbox.

dangerous.//: Groups that keep asking in auto mode. Also available: network, history_rewrite, clobber.
